default_stack.state_authority: SQLiteVersionedRepository + SQLiteAppendOnlyLedger (LOCAL) or GitHub JSON observed-HEAD CAS (CHATGPT_GITHUB)

known_limitations: semantic generation/research quality depends on capabilities actually available in the active host session
without an always-on free host, between-session work cannot execute continuously
high-impact external self-modification remains approval/policy gated
account-level ChatGPT Custom Instructions cannot be transactionally controlled by this repository and therefore are optional non-authority pointers only
business repositories may retain denied historical/internal files, but normal UAOS retrieval excludes the superseded controller surfaces listed in RETRIEVAL_POLICY

the current ChatGPT connector surface cannot physically intercept arbitrary out-of-policy manual repository searches; UAOS prevents them from becoming authority through bootstrap/retrieval/binding admission, while the retired controller default branch is physically tombstoned
